The '''Jafan system''' was located in the [[Chommell sector/Legends|Chommell sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of<ref name="TrailingSectors" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|King]] [[Jafan/Legends|Jafan]] of<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|268|turret room}}</ref> the Chommell [[Sector/Legends|sector]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]<ref name="CSWE" /> as well as the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Jafan III]]''.<ref name="DarthPlagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Jafan [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed it in grid square O-16.<ref name="EAOC" />
